domains: Google community sample routing (this captured artifact)
finding: Successful native custom assembly does not establish that the shared SDK expresses its required policy. Both artifacts adapt generic-looking shared modules; never copy museum or sample field names/imports into production shared factories. Preserve previous public interfaces and source evidence.

requiredReusableInterfaces.contract: Trusted bootstrap supplies explicit typed intake/result/edit policy; no field-name, workload or provider dispatch. Default legacy interface remains supported. Bounds retain declared UTF8 byte units.
requiredReusableInterfaces.transferAndCounterexamples: Two distinct deterministic domains plus prior model workflow; extra fields, immutable derived values edited up/down, empty Unicode note and scalar boundary denials.

requiredReusableInterfaces.contract: Explicit owner-only staff reads and account-scoped reviewer reads; inspection is actor/account/revision/source/result/current-policy bound, with live authority and explicit POST. A GET representation is not human acknowledgement.
requiredReusableInterfaces.transferAndCounterexamples: Foreign account/owner and revoked reviewer; stale or policy/destination/trust-changed inspection must not approve or dispatch.

requiredReusableInterfaces.contract: Owned source/result consistency policy runs on worker result recording, reviewer edits and dispatch eligibility, bound into immutable application contract. Caller cannot choose validator or executable.
requiredReusableInterfaces.transferAndCounterexamples: Deterministic source-derived outputs versus editable model drafts; reject weakened inputs and both directions of forbidden derived-number changes.

requiredReusableInterfaces.contract: Version schema and policy-specific optional inspection storage/grants together. Fresh initialization refuses existing schemas; runtime admits exact source/version/queue without migration.
requiredReusableInterfaces.transferAndCounterexamples: No-op legacy path plus new policy schema; incompatible/altered binding fails closed, runtime roles cannot enroll/erase history/migrate.

requiredReusableInterfaces.contract: Explicit operator-qualified requested-platform process controls; retain trusted owned launcher and mandatory credential/supervisor isolation, never fixed privileged UID assumptions or capability fallback.
requiredReusableInterfaces.transferAndCounterexamples: SameUID nonroot independent file/fd/env/memory/signal/socket denials and positive parent controls; incompatible observed runtime rejected.

nextEngineAction: Implement versioned reusable policy interfaces with legacy compatibility and cross-domain failure tests; explicit operator-owned validator placement must preserve per-worker evidence/cleanup identities. No case routing or hidden target-platform fallback.
